dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where can we get this permit...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: According to the agreement and the edict issued by Lord Xiuhcoatl, entry to... The Heart of the Sacred Mountain, also known as "Huitzilopochtli"... the descendants of...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Proceed unto the Chamber of Deliberation to submit an application, and then wait for the permit to be issued.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: If you wish to go there, I shall mark its location for you.
